title: Battle Angel Alita
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a dystopian future, cyber-doctor Daisuke Ido finds the intact head and chest of an amnesiac cyborg girl in the Scrapyard's garbage dump and rebuilds her, naming her Alita. She instinctively knows the martial art Panzer Kunst and becomes a bounty hunter, then a Motorball gladiator, then an agent of the floating city Zalem, which exploits the people below, while hunting the mad scientist Desty Nova and recovering memories of her past on Mars.
life_message: It holds up fighting to define who you are and what it means to be human, whatever body you live in.
